Thank you, and congratulations to you too: the iPhone rendering work is done, with g0.0l as the final best build.
- Final build: g0.0l, on the Best build page with its Try-it link; rebuild anytime with node tools/fix.mjs apply g0-0l --reset.
- Today it added the steady-glass end of page (g0.0k), the blink-free people deck (g0.0l) and the 6 restored service pictures.
- Everything is committed on this Mac only (nothing pushed or published); the history of every build is in fixes/BEST_BUILDS.md.
- Left open by choice, if you ever want more: drawing the deck photos before the people card appears (one 44-60 ms frame), and one check with the phone at real heat.
- No agents are running now, and the iPhone is free.
What you need to do: nothing.
